Anyone But Me누구도 미워하지 않는

“Anyone But Me” (누구도 미워하지 않는) began with Kang Asol’s recognition that trying to love everyone had meant neglecting herself. In her release note, she describes the emptiness of finding herself last in her own love.

BACKGROUND

A little background

The song appears on From Where No One Is, To Where Everyone Is, released on December 1, 2023. In the notes published by POCLANOS, Kang Asol describes the album as a retreat into solitude followed by a return toward the people she misses.

ABOUT THE ARTIST / 강아솔

Kang Asol

Kang Asol is a singer-songwriter whose songs explore loneliness, self-doubt and the wish to keep loving. She writes about feelings that reassurance does not always reach.

She recorded her first album in Jeju in 2012, then worked on her second in Seoul. Her third album, The Day of Love, followed in February 2018.
